## Vendor and product

Name the vendor, product, plan, account type, and feature if known.

## What changed?

Describe the changed default, setting, retention rule, training rule, human-review rule, connected-app behaviour, or contractual term.

## Source

Link to the current vendor source and include the date you checked it.

## Impact

Does this affect consumer users, business users, enterprise/API users, or all users?
